Fixed. The issue was in `src/Carbon/CarbonInterval.php`: `total()` (line 2584) short-circuits to `startDate->diffInUnit()` when the interval was created from a date diff, so any later mutation (e.g. `addSeconds(10)`) was invisible to `totalSeconds` — even though `forHumans()` used the mutated parts.

Changes in `src/Carbon/CarbonInterval.php`:
- Added a private `clearDates()` helper that nulls the stale `startDate`/`endDate`.
- Called it in the mutating methods: `add()` (covers `sub`/`plus`/`minus`), `times()`, `multiply()` (covers `divide`), and in `set()` when a unit property is assigned.

After this, `total()` falls back to computing from the actual interval parts, so `$p->totalSeconds` returns `130` while `forHumans()` output stays `2 minutes 10 seconds`. `tests/CarbonInterval/TotalTest.php` (incl. `testAlterationAfterDiff`) passes, the full `tests/CarbonInterval/` suite passes (423 tests), and the whole test suite shows no new failures (the 9 `PHPStan/MacroTest` errors are pre-existing environment issues, verified against the pristine checkout).
